description:
An easy to use tool that creates optimal cutting plans and accurate costings that you can have confidence in. Input panel sizes and materials, MaxCut does the rest…

MaxCut is designed for your growing cabinetry business. An easy to use cutlist optimizer that creates optimal cutting plans and accurate costings that you can have confidence in.
- Save a fortune on materials! Cut the sheet to its full potential. Avoid costly saw operator mistakes. No more expensive offcuts lying around your workshop or in the bin.
- Accurate quotations. Generate cabinetry quotations quickly, accurately and efficiently, knowing you have the right price and the correct number of sheets for the job every time.
- All the reports you need. Print to email cut lists, supplier order lists, cabinet labels, professional quotes and more with no extra effort.
Updates
- All Languages Fully Translated
  - Every language in MaxCut is now 100% translated, with AI translation used to fill the remaining gaps.
  - Existing translations have been reviewed and corrected, including wrong menu text, report footers and outdated support email addresses.
  - Spot something that reads wrong in your language? Let us know by emailing support@maxcutsoftware.com and we’ll fix it. Click here to see how to volunteer to translate MaxCut.
- Beta Optimization Engine Improvements
  - The Beta Optimization Engine now produces tighter layouts with less material wastage.
- Clearer Messages When a Job Can’t Be Opened
  - Opening a file that isn’t a MaxCut job (e.g. a PDF or Excel file) now shows a clear message instead of Failed to load settings.
  - Job files that are empty, damaged, in use by another program, or missing now explain the problem and what to do next.
  - Your open job stays exactly as it was if another file fails to open.
- Faster Updates
  - From your next update onwards, updating from within MaxCut skips the terms and conditions screen and installs straight away.
- MaxCut now starts faster, because your license is checked online once a day instead of on every launch.
- The support bundle now includes your Windows regional number and currency settings, helping us resolve import and pricing issues faster.
Fixes
- Correct Edging Across Layouts
  - Panels with different edging no longer share a layout, so edging and quantities now match your input items.
  - Group by Edging is now on by default for new users.
  - Existing users: go to Settings > Layout > Layout Grouping and tick Edging to apply this fix.
- Line prices are now calculated exactly. For example, 12 × 5.95 now shows 71.40 instead of 71.41.
- Job Layout (No Occurrence Grouping) now correctly shows x1 for each layout.
- Grain matching now works with materials that use sub sizes on the last sheet only. It no longer shows a Value cannot be null error or incorrectly triggers the Community Edition grain match limit.
- Report footers now print at the correct size in batch prints that mix portrait and landscape reports.
- Importing very large Excel or CSV files no longer runs out of memory. The import preview now shows the first 50 rows.
- Printing labels for a job with no panels (e.g. labour only) now shows “No data to display” instead of an error.
- The Never Rotate description now correctly reads “The length of the panel follows the length of the sheet material.”
- The Expansion Legend no longer appears on layouts without expansions when using the Beta Optimization Engine.
- Adding several library items to a job at once now works reliably, without the Collection was modified error.
- If MaxCut can’t start, it now shows a clear message and records the cause, so support requests can be resolved faster.
